buildCommand: set -e; if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"vite"' package.json; then DIR=.; elif [ -d "Full Frame WEB/frontend" ]; then DIR="Full Frame WEB/frontend"; elif [ -d frontend ]; then DIR=frontend; else echo 'frontend project not found' >&2; exit 1; fi; cd "$DIR" && npm install && npm run build && mkdir -p "$OLDPWD/__vercel_dist__" && cp -r dist/. "$OLDPWD/__vercel_dist__/"
ignoreCommand: bash -c 'if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "master" ] || [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "WEB" ]; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi'
